name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires that the switch be flipped before reaching the exit, not merely at some point before or after it. The clause "RespondedExistence(at_exit, switch_toggled)" allows the switch to be toggled after the exit, violating the "first" wording. Replace it with a hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) (or equivalently Existence(at_exit) with Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit)). Also add a hard Existence(at_exit) goal to ensure the exit is reached. This will enforce that the switch is toggled prior to reaching the exit and that the exit is indeed reached.

texts: Switch must be toggled before reaching the exit.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u3
(u1, at_exit) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_exit, u3) -> 11
